performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones mean campaigns shouldn't be live yet — fix infrastructure first.

findings.text: Lead drought confirmed: 0 leads from 210 Meta clicks and $104.96 spend across 28 days — conversion tracking or landing page is broken, not the ads.
5 of 9 SOW milestones were due 2026-07-31 and remain undelivered: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account+CAPI, and landing pages+tracking.
4 additional SOW milestones overdue by Sep 1–Sep 11: Meta lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and reactivation nurture sequences — all undelivered.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for last 3 days (Sep 8–10) vs avg ~3/day prior — organic local visibility dropped sharply as paid spend rose.
GA4 sessions crashed to 5 on Sep 10 vs 154–156 the prior two days — a likely tracking or site outage, not a traffic drop.

suggestions.text: Pause all Meta spend immediately until conversion tracking and landing pages are confirmed live — $104.96 spent with 0 leads is a confirmed leak.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause the WARM-RETARGETING campaign and all active Meta ad sets until the landing pages and pixel/CAPI conversion tracking milestone (overdue since 2026-07-31) is verified end-to-end. We have spent $104.96 with 210 clicks and zero recorded leads — money is moving with no intake. Success check: a test lead fires in GHL and GA4 before any budget is restored. Target resolution: 2026-09-14.

suggestions.text: Investigate GA4 session crash to 5 on Sep 10 — likely site or tag outage; resolve before any traffic data is trusted.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded only 5 sessions on 2026-09-10 versus 154–156 on the two preceding days. Check GTM container status, site uptime logs, and GA4 data stream health for that date. Success check: root cause identified and confirmed resolved, session counts return to 100+ baseline. Target: 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 8–10) after averaging ~3/day — re-check on 2026-09-14 before escalating.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions for MedStation Weston fell to 0 on Sep 8, 9, and 10 after averaging roughly 3 per day across August. This could reflect a listing issue, a GBP suspension, or a data pipeline gap coinciding with the SOW GBP triage milestone being overdue. No action is taken this cycle; re-check on 2026-09-14 to determine if it is a sustained drop requiring escalation.
